summary: Supported route (FS-GG/.github#5193, 2026-11-01) for Playwright Chromium on fdev: ~/.local/bin/fdev-chromium-env [--gpu|--no-gpu] -- <cmd...> over the bundle ~/.local/share/fdev-chromium/<version>/ (home disk, persistent). Why: Playwright chromium_headless_shell-1243 (Chrome 153.0.8010.12) fails on fdev with 'libnspr4.so: cannot open shared object file'; ldd lists libnspr4, libnss3, libnssutil3, libatk-1.0, libatk-bridge-2.0, libXcomposite, libXdamage, libXfixes, libXrandr, libatspi missing (full chrome also libsmime3, libcups), and no fonts are installed. The fdev root disk is regenerated on upgrade and image changes are Home-only, so a system install is not durable. What: the wrapper prepends the bundle's usr/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH and sets FONTCONFIG_FILE; it does not set Chromium flags, because neither Chromium nor Playwright reads launch flags from an env var, so it exports FDEV_CHROMIUM_ARGS and FDEV_CHROMIUM_ARGS_JSON for the launcher's args. --no-gpu: --disable-gpu --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --use-angle=swiftshader (SwiftShader WebGL). --gpu: --use-angle=vulkan --enable-features=Vulkan --ignore-gpu-blocklist (WebGL renderer ANGLE AMD Vulkan 1.4.354 RADV RAPHAEL_MENDOCINO). Default Chromium flags silently fall back to SwiftShader, so hardware needs the --gpu flags; --use-angle=gl gives no WebGL. Bundle: official Arch packages downloaded with pacman -Sw -dd --disable-sandbox --cachedir (never installed), extracted with bsdtar, pruned, with manifest.json recording each package's name, version, file sha256 and every extracted file's sha256: at-spi2-core 2.62.1-1, libcups 2:2.4.20-1, libxcomposite 0.4.7-1, libxdamage 1.1.7-1, libxfixes 6.0.2-1, libxi 1.8.3-1, libxrandr 1.5.5-1, libxtst 1.2.5-1, nspr 4.40-1, nss 3.131-1, ttf-dejavu 2.37+18+g9b5d1b2f-8, ttf-liberation 2.1.5-2. Fonts: DejaVu and Liberation via a bundled fonts.conf and fontcache. Observed 2026-11-01 (smoke: red box, white background, dark glyph pixels for three text blocks, page text, bundled fonts chosen by Chromium, WebGL string): passed for headless shell and channel chromium in both modes; without the wrapper the same script fails on libnspr4. Limits: the bundle and wrapper live on the home disk, not in Git; only the package list and recipe are recorded here, and the usage page is docs/coordination/2026-11-01-fdev-headless-chromium.md. Versions are the Arch Linux Archive snapshot of 2026-10-12 and may be superseded at rebuild. Do not export LD_LIBRARY_PATH globally. The durable image change (add the same packages) is a held SystemAdmin source proposal; image rebuilds are Home-only. Verify the bundle with fdev-chromium-env --check before relying on this after any fdev image or Playwright change.
title: fdev headless Chromium: hash-recorded runtime-lib and font bundle with one wrapper (fdev-chromium-env, --gpu/--no-gpu)
